title: Every project's tasks return 404
hints: Add a console.log of req.params at the top of the middleware in src/tasksRouter and run the tests.
A router only sees the URL params of its own paths unless you tell it otherwise. Look at how express.Router is called, and at where :projectId is defined.
Use express.Router({ mergeParams: true }). Then log typeof req.params.projectId: URLs are text, but the ids in src/store are numbers.

hiddenTestRules.project tasks > only finds a task under: A task is only found under the project it belongs to; under any other project it's 404 with { error: 'Task not found' }.
hiddenTestRules.project tasks > treats an id that only s: An id that isn't exactly a real id, like 1abc, is treated as not found.
hiddenTestRules.project tasks > gives a new task its pro: A new task's projectId is the project's number, not text: 1, not '1'.
hiddenTestRules.project tasks > lists a new task in its: A new task then shows up in its project's list.
hiddenTestRules.project tasks > regression: rejects a ta: A new task needs a non-empty title; otherwise it's 400 with { error: 'Title is required' }.
